author: Claude
note: Proposed additions/changes to docs/shinsekai/colors.json. Only the White Tower's whiteness has a written source; every other hue is an art-direction estimate from grayscale tone, hand-tinted postcards (artist's colouring, not measurement) or period technology. Sources: claude-out/research/facts.md, c4-review.md, design-brief.md.

changes.note: Single red body is supported by one modern retrospective only; the period hand-tinted postcard shows a striped awning and a pale painted body. Split into the entries below.

Three independent hand-tinted postcards (OML CC0 157431, 157437, 159201) colour the lattice red-brown (red-oxide-like). Grayscale darkness is consistent. Prefer red-brown unless contrary evidence appears.
Base reads very light in 1914/1921 photos; slightly lighter warm plaster/stone-imitation. Saito 1985: four storeys, stone-like.

additions.basis: Saito 1985 p.18: called 'White Tower' because the amusement hall was painted white. Slight warm off-white to avoid clipping in daylight.

additions.material: striped canvas awning with scalloped edge
additions.basis: Period hand-tinted postcard 'The air ship and white tower' (V005 5:12-5:15) shows multi-colour vertical stripes; order and exact hues are the colourist's. Saito 1985: tent roof on a frame.

additions.material: painted boat-shaped car body with flower decoration
additions.basis: OML CC0 157431 and 159201 (hand-tinted) show a red car; V005 postcard shows a pale body with flowers; THE PAGE retrospective says red. Proposal: red body, striped awning.

additions.material: evergreen foliage covering the opening-day gate
additions.basis: Opening postcard of the 恵美須通 gate covered with greenery ('祝開業'); species unknown.

additions.material: small pennants on ropes radiating from the tower top
additions.basis: Pennant ropes are photographed (NDL 952032 canvas 95, V007); colours unknown.

additions.material: early incandescent lamp (carbon/early tungsten), approx. 2000-2400 K
additions.basis: Period technology; warmer and dimmer than modern lamps. Use instead of a neutral warm white.

additions.material: coloured electric light on the White Tower waterfall (夜光の瀧)
additions.basis: 南海の栞 1912 p.44 '五色のイルミネーション…瀑布に映じ'; 新世界興隆史 1934 '五彩の電光'. The five actual colours are not stated; red/blue/green/yellow/white is an estimate.

additions.material: light rising from the bottom of 真澄の池 at night
additions.basis: 新世界興隆史 1934 p.41 'rainbow light rises from the pond bottom'; colour estimated.

additions.material: summer haze / smoke over the city ('煙の都')
additions.basis: Art direction: distant hills and city fade to blue-grey.
1914 photos show unpaved light-toned streets with tram rails; colour estimated.
